versions.changelog:
- Initial release of martin-video skill (veo).
- Generate video clips using SkillBoss API Hub, auto-routing to the best model.
- Supports prompt-based video generation with customizable duration and aspect ratio.
- Optional model specification and image-to-video support.
- Requires SKILLBOSS_API_KEY environment variable.
- Output videos in MP4 format; script prints a MEDIA: line for chat integration.
